items.title: US military strikes Iranian boats and missile launch sites
items.description: US Centcom says the strikes were designed "to protect our troops from threats posed by Iranian forces".

items.title: Travel company collapses, leaving customers stranded
items.description: An Australian travel company selling heavily discounted international holidays has collapsed, leaving customers scrambling and their plans in disarray.

items.title: Kumanjayi White family 'heartbroken' no charges laid over custody death
items.description: The family of Kumanjayi White tell the ABC they are "heartbroken" that no charges will be laid over his death in custody, as Northern Territory Police confirm their criminal investigation has been concluded.

items.title: Scathing warning to people harassing royal commission witnesses
items.description: Four officers were present at the event when the shooting started, with Jewish security organisation Community Security Group NSW denied its request to have police on patrol for the entirety of the event.

items.title: Live: Angus Taylor pressures PM to detail small business CGT carve-outs in QT
items.description: The opposition leader has pressured the prime minister to reveal details of small business carve-outs for capital gains tax discount changes. Follow live.

items.title: Iron ore processing project dumped by BHP for not being profitable enough
items.description: Internal BHP documents reveal how the mining giant planned to set up an iron ore processing facility in the Pilbara to cut carbon emissions before backing away from it entirely.

items.title: Santos boss 'can't believe' gas reservation would force loss-making prices
items.description: The federal government's draft framework would require gas producers to supply 20 per cent of their exports to the domestic market, with limited exceptions, which gas producers warn would "undermine" future supply.

items.title: Police taskforce investigating Dezi Freeman arrests two men
items.description: Detectives investigating the movements of police killer Dezi Freeman have arrested two men in Victoria's north-east.

items.title: K-pop triumphs at American Music Awards as Pussycat Dolls lead noughties nostalgia
items.description: Taylor Swift led the night with eight nominations but didn't take home a single award, while 80s rock star Billy Idol was honoured with a Lifetime Achievement Award.

items.title: Hypersonic missile attack a sign of Putin's 'bruised ego', expert says
items.description: Russia escalates attacks on Kyiv, using a hypersonic missile in one of its largest assaults on the Ukrainian capital since the start of the four-year war, and warns foreigners to leave the city ahead of further strikes.

items.title: 'ISIS bride' under exclusion order not returning to Australia, ABC confirms
items.description: The majority of the final group of Australians living in a notorious Syrian camp for the families of killed and captured Islamic State militants are expected to arrive in Australia soon. Here's what we know about them.

items.title: Fan in Australian jersey catches Aussie-hit homer in 15-year first
items.description: Curtis Mead hit two home runs for Washington against fellow Australian Travis Bazzana's Cleveland side as two Australian-born players faced off in an MLB game for the first time since 2017. But it was a man in an Australian supporters shirt who stole the show.

items.title: After losing her 3yo daughter, one mum says MDMA therapy saved her life
items.description: Jess Yugovich is among the Australians trying MDMA-assisted psychotherapy after being diagnosed with PTSD, as highly regulated facilities process the drug for therapeutic use.

items.title: One woman will make Japanese history by going on maternity leave
items.description: A Japanese mayor will take maternity leave this year, becoming the first in the country's history to do so while in office.

items.title: The many phases of Miles Davis, who would have turned 100 today
items.description: From Illinois to New York to Australia, legendary trumpeter Miles Davis helped shape the direction of jazz with albums like Birth of the Cool and Kind of Blue.

items.title: Using AI to manage your budget? This is what experts want you to know
items.description: "Hallucinations", privacy and other factors to consider if you're turning to artificial intelligence for financial advice.

items.title: I'm making a conscious effort to break free from unspoken family trauma
items.description: Motherhood has a way of making family patterns impossible to ignore. Suddenly you start asking questions you never asked before.

items.title: 'Catastrophic failure' after drones malfunction at Vivid Sydney show
items.description: The incident occurred not long into Monday's 7.30pm "star-bound" show when almost 90 drones began falling out of formation and into the harbour around Cockle Bay.

items.title: Power price drops for most customers as batteries flatten peak
items.description: Surging levels of renewable energy and better reliability from coal-fired generators are set to give consumers a break, with benchmark power prices to fall up to 10 per cent for consumers and more for small businesses.

items.title: Live: Australian stocks fall as US strikes dampen investor sentiment
items.description: The local share market is in the red, while shares in stock exchange operator ASX Ltd have tumbled on a trading update. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: Teary council officer tells ICAC they 'should be ashamed of yourselves'
items.description: Roxanne Thornton accuses Independent Commission Against Corruption of "laying the boot in" after four days of questioning over the manipulation of the recruitment process at the council to secure jobs for friends and associates.

items.title: Spirit ferries operator set for major restructure under Tasmanian Labor plan
items.description: The two government businesses responsible for the botched Spirit of Tasmania ship replacement program would undergo a major restructure, with one stripped of all assets, under a Tasmanian Labor government.

items.title: Late pastoralist's family loses appeal over judgement that father was responsible for bushfire
items.description: A court judgement that found pastoralist Tom Brinkworth liable for a 2021 bushfire, five months after he died, has been upheld after an appeal by Mr Brinkworth's family.

items.title: Israeli politician calls for investigation after Gaza flotilla activists allege abuse
items.description: One of Israel's most prominent opposition politicians has called for an investigation into the alleged abuse of activists from the Global Sumud Flotilla, which was intercepted by the Israeli military in the Mediterranean last week.

items.title: Bringing Them Home inaction a 'woeful failure', ex-commissioner says
items.description: Mick Dodson heard "soul-destroying" testimony from more than 500 First Nations people during a landmark inquiry. He says that 29 years later, it's time for action.
